environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed with awsvpc network mode. Task definition specifies linuxParameters with capabilities dropped: CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Container uses a read-only root filesystem. The task's awsvpc ENI is associated with security group sg-0a4f8e2c that has egress rules limited to port 443 on prefix list pl-02cd2c6b (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) and the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 on port 443 only. A VPC endpoint policy on the credentials relay endpoint (169.254.170.2) restricts the relative URI path to only /v2/credentials/{task-credential-id} with a condition that the request must originate from the task ENI. Additionally, the task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/fargate-boundary) that denies iam:* and sts:AssumeRole. The ECS service is fronted by an internal ALB with an AWS WAF WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/chat-svc-acl) that includes AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING in COUNT mode and a custom rule that blocks requests where the query string contains any URI matching the regex pattern `169\.254\.|metadata|\[::ffff:` with action BLOCK, priority 1.
